description: Fork of exp108 with smaller dims: E=256, d_qk=32, d_v=42 (H=6, H*d_v=252, out_proj LUT 252->256). Other settings (balanced-coverage scatter, nap=10, n_sparse=1, qk/v tph=768, out tph=4096) match exp108. Tables/output: qk 768/64=12 exact, v_lut 768/42=18.28 (12 slots get 19, 30 slots get 18), out_proj 4096/256=16 exact. LUT weights unchanged (decoupled from E by sparse_scatter); only embedding/unembedder shrink.
